title: Color Codes - SMAUGFUSS/SWR Style
body:
&CCOLOR CODES - SMAUGFUSS/SWR STYLE&x

Every color starts with &. Lowercase is DARK; uppercase is BRIGHT.
&w is gray, &W is bright white, &m is dark purple and &M is bright magenta.
The codes at left are literal and copyable. Named colors clear lingering bold.

&WLOWERCASE - DARK COLORS&x
  &&r  &rDark red&x
  &&g  &gDark green&x
  &&y  &yDark yellow&x
  &&b  &bDark blue&x
  &&c  &cDark cyan&x
  &&m  &mDark purple&x
  &&w  &wGray&x
  &&d  &dDark gray&x
  &&z  &zBlack&x
  &&o  &oDark orange&x

&WUPPERCASE - BRIGHT COLORS&x
  &&R  &RBright red&x
  &&G  &GBright green&x
  &&Y  &YBright yellow&x
  &&B  &BBright blue&x
  &&C  &CBright cyan&x
  &&M  &MBright magenta&x
  &&W  &WBright white&x
  &&D  &DLight gray&x
  &&Z  &ZCharcoal&x
  &&O  &OBright orange&x

&WCONTROL CODES&x
  &&x    Reset all terminal formatting
  &&&&    Display a literal ampersand (&)

&WEXTENDED 256-COLOR PALETTE&x
  &&N or &&[N] selects any xterm color number 0 through 255.
  &&[196]  &[196]Bright xterm red&x
  &&[208]  &[208]Orange&x
  &&[27]   &[27]Deep blue&x
  &&[129]  &[129]Purple&x
  &&[226]  &[226]Bright yellow&x
  &o is dark orange; &O is bright orange.
  The numbered palette is independent of letter case.
  Your terminal/MUD client must support ANSI/256-color rendering.

&WEXAMPLES&x
  Type: prompt &&RHP:%h/%H &&BCH:%c/%C &&GST:%s/%S&&x
  Preview: &RHP:100/120 &BCH:150/200 &GST:75/90&x
  Type: prompt &&w|&&R%h&&w/&&196%H&&w|&&M%c&&w/&&m%C&&w|&&x
  Preview: &w|&R100&w/&196120&w|&M150&w/&m200&w|&x

&WNOTES&x
  Colors continue until the next valid code or &&x reset.
  Example: &&&&r displays literal &&r instead of changing the color.
  Invalid numbered colors outside 0-255 do not render colors.
  Color OFF strips formatting, leaving readable text.
  See HELP PROMPT for prompt customization and presets.
